تمتلكي (form VIII)
# تَمْتَلِكِي (tamtalikī) /tam.ta.li.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# تُمْتَلَكِي (tumtalakī) /tum.ta.la.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
